```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
if (params$save_png) dir.create(params$out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r load-data}
years       <- seq(2020, 2050, 5)
table_years <- c(2020, 2030, 2035, 2040, 2050)
EJ_TO_MTOE  <- 23.884589   # same factor as unit_table.R
GWP_CH4 <- 27.2; GWP_N2O <- 0.273

# Reference workbook (sheet "data", Model column) or a step3 csv. The 2021 base
# year of GCAM 9.1 is shown in the 2020 column.
read_iamc <- function(f) {
  d <- if (grepl("\\.xlsx$", f)) read_excel(f, sheet = "data") else read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)
  d <- as.data.frame(d)
  names(d) <- trimws(names(d))
  if ("2021" %in% names(d) && !"2020" %in% names(d)) names(d)[names(d) == "2021"] <- "2020"
  d <- d %>% mutate(across(any_of(c("Model", "Scenario", "Region", "Variable", "Unit")), ~ trimws(as.character(.x))))
  yc <- grep("^[0-9]{4}$", names(d), value = TRUE)
  d[yc] <- lapply(d[yc], function(x) replace_na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)), 0))
  d
}
# File names with Korean letters may be stored in NFD form: match NFC-normalized
a_file <- params$a_file
if (!file.exists(a_file)) {
  cand <- list.files(dirname(a_file), full.names = TRUE)
  a_file <- cand[stringi::stri_trans_nfc(basename(cand)) == stringi::stri_trans_nfc(basename(a_file))][1]
}
a_is_template <- grepl("\\.csv$", a_file)
a_all <- read_iamc(a_file)
if (!a_is_template && "Model" %in% names(a_all)) a_all <- a_all %>% filter(Model == params$a_model)
a_scen <- unlist(params$a_scenarios); a_scen <- a_scen[nzchar(a_scen)]
if (length(a_scen) == 0) a_scen <- unique(a_all$Scenario)
a_ov <- a_all %>% filter(Scenario %in% a_scen)

b_template <- read_iamc(params$b_template)
b_scen <- unlist(params$b_scenarios); b_scen <- b_scen[nzchar(b_scen)]
if (length(b_scen) == 0) b_scen <- unique(b_template$Scenario)
b_ov <- b_template %>% filter(Scenario %in% b_scen)
b_korea <- read_iamc(params$b_korea) %>% filter(Region == "South Korea", Scenario %in% b_scen)
ref_korea <- if (nzchar(params$ref_korea_csv) && file.exists(params$ref_korea_csv))
  read_iamc(params$ref_korea_csv) %>% filter(Region == "South Korea") else NULL

stopifnot(nrow(a_ov) > 0, nrow(b_ov) > 0,
          params$pair_a %in% a_all$Scenario, params$pair_b %in% b_template$Scenario)
lab_a <- function(s) paste(params$a_label, s)
lab_b <- function(s) paste(params$b_label, s)
year_labels <- function(x) ifelse(x == 2020, "2020/21", as.character(x))
fmt <- function(x, digits = 1) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = ",")
```

This report compares the run **`r params$b_label`** (scenarios `r paste(b_scen, collapse = ", ")`) with the reference **`r params$a_label`** (`r if (a_is_template) "step3 output of an earlier run" else paste0("submission workbook, model ", params$a_model)`; scenarios `r paste(a_scen, collapse = ", ")`).

- Part 1: all scenarios side by side (GHG in the KMIP template scope, national gross/net GHG, primary energy, electricity, final energy by sector).
- Part 2: one scenario pair, `r lab_a(params$pair_a)` (A) vs `r lab_b(params$pair_b)` (B), variable by variable.
- GCAM 9.1 has no 2020 period; its 2021 values sit in the 2020 column, shown as "2020/21". The reference 2020 values of a submission workbook are inventory values, not model output.
- Bunker rule (international aviation/shipping removed): this pipeline keeps the domestic shares 0.099 / 0.039 (GIR 2023); the KMIP2025 submission used 0.093 / 0.032.
- Sign convention: a submission workbook reports CCS as negative numbers, step3 outputs as positive. Carbon sequestration is shown as positive amounts.

```{r part1-functions}
# Pick the first candidate variable set that exists in d and sum it by scenario and year.
get_var <- function(d, cands) {
  for (vs in cands) {
    hit <- d %>% filter(Variable %in% vs)
    if (nrow(hit) > 0)
      return(hit %>% pivot_longer(matches("^[0-9]{4}$"), names_to = "year", values_to = "value") %>%
               mutate(year = as.integer(year)) %>%
               group_by(Scenario, year) %>% summarise(value = sum(value), .groups = "drop"))
  }
  tibble(Scenario = unique(d$Scenario)) %>% crossing(year = years) %>% mutate(value = 0)
}
# items = list(category = list(candidate sets)); total gives an "Other" = total - items row
build <- function(d, items, total = NULL, factor = 1) {
  parts <- bind_rows(lapply(names(items), function(nm) get_var(d, items[[nm]]) %>% mutate(category = nm)))
  if (!is.null(total)) {
    tot <- get_var(d, total)
    other <- tot %>% left_join(parts %>% group_by(Scenario, year) %>% summarise(s = sum(value), .groups = "drop"),
                               by = c("Scenario", "year")) %>%
      transmute(Scenario, year, value = value - s, category = "Other")
    parts <- bind_rows(parts, other)
  }
  parts %>% mutate(value = value * factor)
}
# KMIP template scope: CO2 + CH4 + N2O from energy, industrial process GHG, minus DAC
ghg_scope <- function(d) {
  vars <- c("Emissions|CO2|Energy", "Emissions|CH4|Energy", "Emissions|N2O|Energy",
            "Emissions|GHGs|Non-Energy|Industrial Process")
  dac <- get_var(d, list("Carbon Sequestration|DAC")) %>% mutate(value = -abs(value))
  bind_rows(get_var(d, list(vars)), dac) %>% group_by(Scenario, year) %>% summarise(value = sum(value), .groups = "drop")
}
# National total from the step2 Korea csv (IAMC names): net = Kyoto Gases, gross = net - LULUCF
ghg_national <- function(d) {
  kyoto <- get_var(d, list("Emissions|Kyoto Gases"))
  luc   <- get_var(d, list("Emissions|CO2|AFOLU"))
  land  <- get_var(d, list("Emissions|Kyoto Gases|AFOLU|Land"))
  kyoto %>% rename(net = value) %>%
    left_join(luc %>% rename(luc = value), by = c("Scenario", "year")) %>%
    left_join(land %>% rename(land = value), by = c("Scenario", "year")) %>%
    transmute(Scenario, year, `Net (incl. LULUCF)` = net, `Gross (excl. LULUCF)` = net - luc - land) %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(Scenario, year), names_to = "category", values_to = "value")
}
pe_fuels <- c("Coal", "Oil", "Gas", "Biomass", "Nuclear", "Hydro", "Solar", "Wind", "Geothermal")
pe_items <- setNames(lapply(pe_fuels, function(f) list(paste0("Primary Energy|", f))), pe_fuels)
el_items <- list(
  Coal = list(paste0("Secondary Energy|Electricity|Coal|", c("w/ CCS", "w/o CCS"))),
  Oil = list(paste0("Secondary Energy|Electricity|Oil|", c("w/ CCS", "w/o CCS"))),
  Gas = list(paste0("Secondary Energy|Electricity|Gas|", c("w/ CCS", "w/o CCS"))),
  Biomass = list(paste0("Secondary Energy|Electricity|Biomass|", c("w/ CCS", "w/o CCS"))),
  Nuclear = list("Secondary Energy|Electricity|Nuclear"),
  Hydro = list("Secondary Energy|Electricity|Hydro"),
  Solar = list(c("Secondary Energy|Electricity|Solar|PV", "Secondary Energy|Electricity|Solar|CSP")),
  Wind = list(c("Secondary Energy|Electricity|Wind|Onshore", "Secondary Energy|Electricity|Wind|Offshore")),
  Hydrogen = list("Secondary Energy|Electricity|Hydrogen"))
fe_items_template <- list(
  Industry = list("Final Energy|Industry"), Transportation = list("Final Energy|Transportation"),
  Buildings = list("Final Energy|Building"), AFOFI = list("Final Energy|AFOFI"))
fe_items_iamc <- list(
  Industry = list("Final Energy|Industry"), Transportation = list("Final Energy|Transportation"),
  Buildings = list("Final Energy|Residential and Commercial", "Final Energy|Buildings",
                   c("Final Energy|Residential", "Final Energy|Commercial")),
  AFOFI = list("Final Energy|Agriculture"),
  `Non-energy use` = list("Final Energy|Non-Energy Use"),
  `Intl. bunkers` = list("Final Energy|Bunkers"))

tag <- function(df, labf) df %>% mutate(series = labf(Scenario))
# A series in grays, B series in colors; "ref" scenarios dashed
series_levels <- c(lab_a(a_scen), lab_b(b_scen))
b_cols <- c("#d03b2f", "#2a78d6", "#1b8a5a", "#eda100", "#8e44ad", "#e87ba4", "#008080", "#7f6000")
series_col <- c(setNames(gray.colors(length(a_scen), start = 0.15, end = 0.7), lab_a(a_scen)),
                setNames(rep_len(b_cols, length(b_scen)), lab_b(b_scen)))
series_lty <- c(setNames(rep("solid", length(a_scen)), lab_a(a_scen)),
                setNames(ifelse(grepl("ref", b_scen, ignore.case = TRUE), "dashed", "solid"), lab_b(b_scen)))
series_lwd <- c(setNames(rep(0.6, length(a_scen)), lab_a(a_scen)), setNames(rep(1.1, length(b_scen)), lab_b(b_scen)))
cat_fill <- c(Coal = "#3d3d3d", Oil = "#8c564b", Gas = "#7fb3e6", Biomass = "#5aa05a",
              Nuclear = "#9467bd", Hydro = "#1f5fa8", Solar = "#f2c12e", Wind = "#5cc8c0",
              Geothermal = "#d98c5f", Hydrogen = "#e377c2", Other = "#c8c8c8",
              Industry = "#4a6fa5", Transportation = "#e07b39", Buildings = "#6aa84f",
              AFOFI = "#b39b5c", `Non-energy use` = "#8fb8d8", `Intl. bunkers` = "#9e9e9e")
base_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"), legend.text = element_text(size = 14))

order_series <- function(d) d %>% filter(series %in% series_levels) %>%
  mutate(series = factor(series, levels = intersect(series_levels, unique(series))))
line_plot <- function(d, ylab, facet = FALSE) {
  d <- order_series(d) %>% filter(year %in% years)
  ggplot(d, aes(year, value, color = series, linetype = series, linewidth = series)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_line() +
    {if (facet) facet_wrap(~category)} +
    scale_color_manual(values = series_col, name = NULL) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = series_lty, name = NULL) +
    scale_linewidth_manual(values = series_lwd, name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = years, labels = year_labels) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ylab) + base_theme
}
bar_plot <- function(d, ylab) {
  d <- order_series(d) %>% filter(year %in% table_years)
  cats <- intersect(names(cat_fill), unique(d$category))
  d <- d %>% mutate(category = factor(category, levels = rev(cats)), year = year_labels(year))
  ggplot(d, aes(series, value, fill = category)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.3) +
    facet_wrap(~year, nrow = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cat_fill, breaks = cats, name = NULL) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ylab) + base_theme +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1, size = 11))
}
totals <- function(d) d %>% group_by(series, year) %>% summarise(value = sum(value), .groups = "drop")
# Wide table: one row per series, one column per table year
wide_table <- function(d, digits = 0) {
  w <- order_series(d) %>% filter(year %in% table_years) %>% arrange(series, year) %>%
    mutate(value = fmt(value, digits)) %>% select(series, year, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = value) %>% rename(Scenario = series)
  names(w)[names(w) == "2020"] <- "2020/21"
  knitr::kable(w, align = c("l", rep("r", ncol(w) - 1)))
}
save_part1 <- function(name, p, d) {
  if (!params$save_png) return(invisible())
  ggsave(file.path(params$out_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), p, width = 16, height = 9, dpi = 100, bg = "white")
  write_csv(d %>% filter(year %in% years) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = value),
            file.path(params$out_dir, paste0(name, ".csv")))
}
```

```{r fig1b}
fig1b <- ghg_national(b_korea) %>% tag(lab_b)
if (!is.null(ref_korea)) {
  ref_lab <- function(s) paste(params$a_label, s, "(rerun)")
  ref_scen <- unique(ref_korea$Scenario)
  series_levels <<- c(series_levels, ref_lab(ref_scen))
  series_col <<- c(series_col, setNames(gray.colors(length(ref_scen), 0.1, 0.7), ref_lab(ref_scen)))
  series_lty <<- c(series_lty, setNames(rep("solid", length(ref_scen)), ref_lab(ref_scen)))
  series_lwd <<- c(series_lwd, setNames(rep(0.6, length(ref_scen)), ref_lab(ref_scen)))
  fig1b <- bind_rows(ghg_national(ref_korea) %>% tag(ref_lab), fig1b)
}
p <- line_plot(fig1b, "Mt CO2eq/yr", facet = TRUE); print(p); save_part1("fig1b_ghg_national_gross_net", p, fig1b)
```

Net = Emissions|Kyoto Gases (incl. LULUCF). Gross = Net - CO2 AFOLU - Kyoto AFOLU|Land (as the GHG pathway figure). From the step2 Korea csv; a submission workbook has no national total, so the reference appears here only when `compare_ref_korea_csv` points at a step2 csv of the reference database.

# Part 2: `r lab_a(params$pair_a)` vs `r lab_b(params$pair_b)`

```{r part2-data}
lab_a2 <- lab_a(params$pair_a); lab_b2 <- lab_b(params$pair_b)
to_long <- function(df, label) {
  df %>% select(variable = Variable, unit = Unit, any_of(as.character(years))) %>%
    mutate(across(any_of(as.character(years)), as.numeric)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(variable, unit), names_to = "year", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(year = as.numeric(year), source = label) %>% filter(!is.na(value))
}
combined_data <- bind_rows(to_long(a_all %>% filter(Scenario == params$pair_a), lab_a2),
                           to_long(b_template %>% filter(Scenario == params$pair_b), lab_b2)) %>%
  mutate(source = factor(source, levels = c(lab_a2, lab_b2)))
unit_of <- combined_data %>% distinct(variable, unit) %>% filter(!is.na(unit)) %>%
  group_by(variable) %>% summarise(unit = first(unit))
```

Each section: stacked bars (A left, B right, same y scale), a totals table (Diff = B - A) and a variable table for 2030 and 2050. Variables that are zero or missing in both scenarios are dropped. The sub-sector sections are mostly empty in a submission workbook; use a step3 csv of the reference database as `compare_a_file` to fill them. Capacity Additions: the KMIP2025 workbook has zeros and the GCAM 9.1 values look wrong; do not use that section yet.

```{r part2-functions}
pal20 <- c("#1F77B4", "#AEC7E8", "#FF7F0E", "#FFBB78", "#2CA02C", "#98DF8A", "#D62728",
           "#FF9896", "#9467BD", "#C5B0D5", "#8C564B", "#C49C94", "#E377C2", "#F7B6D2",
           "#7F7F7F", "#C7C7C7", "#BCBD22", "#DBDB8D", "#17BECF", "#9EDAE5")
# Shortest legend label: drop the prefix shared by all variables
short_names <- function(v) {
  if (length(v) == 1) return(v)
  if (any(str_detect(v, "^Emissions\\|"))) return(str_remove(v, "^Emissions\\|[^|]+\\|(Energy\\|)?"))
  parts <- str_split(v, fixed("|"))
  n <- 0
  while (n < min(lengths(parts)) - 1 && length(unique(map_chr(parts, ~ .x[n + 1]))) == 1) n <- n + 1
  map_chr(parts, ~ paste(.x[(n + 1):length(.x)], collapse = "|"))
}
section_data <- function(sec) {
  all_vars <- c(sec$pos, sec$pos2, sec$neg)
  d <- combined_data %>% filter(variable %in% all_vars) %>% select(-unit) %>%
    complete(variable, source, year = years, fill = list(value = 0)) %>%
    mutate(value = if_else(variable %in% sec$neg, -abs(value), value),
           value = if (isTRUE(sec$abs_all)) abs(value) else value)
  keep <- d %>% group_by(variable) %>% summarise(nz = any(abs(value) > 1e-9)) %>% filter(nz) %>% pull(variable)
  d %>% filter(variable %in% keep) %>% mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = intersect(all_vars, keep)))
}
section_unit <- function(sec) {
  u <- unit_of %>% filter(variable %in% c(sec$pos, sec$pos2, sec$neg)) %>% pull(unit) %>% unique()
  if (length(u) == 0) "" else u[1]
}
make_plot <- function(d, unit) {
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "No data", size = 8) + theme_void())
  vars <- levels(d$variable)
  cols <- if (length(vars) <= 20) pal20[seq_along(vars)] else colorRampPalette(pal20)(length(vars))
  ggplot(d, aes(x = year, y = value, fill = variable)) +
    geom_col(width = 4, position = "stack") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
    facet_wrap(~ source, ncol = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(cols, vars), labels = short_names(vars), name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = years, labels = year_labels) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = unit) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 20) +
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
          strip.text = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold"),
          axis.text = element_text(color = "black"), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.9, "cm"), legend.position = "right")
}
reported_total <- function(sec) {
  if (is.null(sec$total)) return(NULL)
  combined_data %>% filter(variable == sec$total) %>%
    mutate(source = if_else(source == lab_a2, "A_reported", "B_reported")) %>%
    select(year, source, value) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = value)
}
totals_table <- function(d) {
  d %>% group_by(source, year) %>% summarise(total = sum(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = total) %>%
    rename(A = all_of(lab_a2), B = all_of(lab_b2)) %>%
    mutate(Diff = B - A, `Diff (%)` = if_else(abs(A) > 1e-9, 100 * Diff / A, NA_real_))
}
detail_table <- function(d, yr) {
  d %>% filter(year == yr) %>%
    mutate(variable = as.character(variable), source = if_else(source == lab_a2, "A", "B")) %>%
    select(variable, source, value) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = value) %>%
    select(variable, A, B) %>%
    mutate(Diff = B - A, `Diff (%)` = if_else(abs(A) > 1e-9, 100 * Diff / A, NA_real_))
}
```

```{r run-sections, results='asis', fig.width=16, fig.height=9}
all_detail <- list()
for (sec in sections) {
  d <- section_data(sec)
  unit <- section_unit(sec)
  p <- make_plot(d, unit)

  cat("\n\n```{=latex}\n\\newpage\n```\n\n")
  cat("## ", gsub("|", "\\|", sec$title, fixed = TRUE), "\n\n", sep = "")
  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")
  if (nrow(d) == 0) next
  zero_src <- d %>% group_by(source) %>% summarise(nz = any(abs(value) > 1e-9), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(!nz) %>% pull(source)
  if (length(zero_src) > 0)
    cat("All values are zero or missing in ", paste(as.character(zero_src), collapse = ", "), ".\n\n", sep = "")

  tot <- totals_table(d)
  if (params$save_png) {
    ggsave(file.path(params$out_dir, paste0(sec$slug, ".png")), p, width = 16, height = 9, dpi = 100, bg = "white")
    rep_tot <- reported_total(sec)
    tot_csv <- if (is.null(rep_tot)) tot else left_join(tot, rep_tot, by = "year")
    write_csv(tot_csv %>% mutate(unit = unit) %>%
                rename(!!paste0("A_", params$pair_a) := A, !!paste0("B_", params$pair_b) := B),
              file.path(params$out_dir, paste0(sec$slug, "_totals.csv")))
  }

  # Table titles as bold lines, not kable captions: pandoc binds a caption that
  # follows a table to that table, so two captioned tables in a row get mixed up.
  tot_show <- tot %>% mutate(year = year_labels(year), across(c(A, B, Diff, `Diff (%)`), fmt))
  cat("**Total by year (", unit, ")**\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(knitr::kable(tot_show, col.names = c("Year", lab_a2, lab_b2, "Diff (B-A)", "Diff (%)"), align = "lrrrr"), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n\n")

  for (yr in c(2030, 2050)) {
    det <- detail_table(d, yr)
    all_detail[[paste(sec$slug, yr)]] <- det %>% mutate(section = sec$title, year = yr, unit = unit)
    det_show <- det %>% filter(abs(Diff) > 1e-6) %>%
      mutate(variable = short_names(variable), across(c(A, B, Diff, `Diff (%)`), fmt))
    if (nrow(det_show) == 0) next
    cat("**", yr, " by variable (", unit, ")**\n\n", sep = "")
    cat(knitr::kable(det_show, col.names = c("Variable", "A", "B", "Diff (B-A)", "Diff (%)"), align = "lrrrr"), sep = "\n")
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
if (params$save_png)
  write_csv(bind_rows(all_detail) %>% relocate(section, year, unit),
            file.path(params$out_dir, "all_sections_by_variable_2030_2050.csv"))
```

## Template variables with values in only one scenario of the pair

```{r only-one}
has_val <- combined_data %>% group_by(variable, source) %>%
  summarise(nz = any(abs(value) > 1e-9), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = nz, values_fill = FALSE)
only <- has_val %>% filter(.data[[lab_a2]] != .data[[lab_b2]]) %>%
  mutate(`Has values in` = if_else(.data[[lab_a2]], lab_a2, lab_b2)) %>%
  select(Variable = variable, `Has values in`) %>% arrange(`Has values in`, Variable)
knitr::kable(only)
```
